review_notes: 104 existing definitions: 57 exact alpha-token substitutions and 47 reviewed structured edits. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

Split cards preserve common availability checks, context-dependent instance queries, first/second resolution order and live info_slot rereads. Discovery keeps repeated CMC queries, targeting and discard order; Consecrate retains its existing scan/state handling.

Preserve Experimental Frenzy stack/cost queries and cached dialog availability, Crush Contraband priorities, locket color and hybrid-cost scans, marked sacrifice handling and Nullhide Ferox inclusive scans and opponent-legacy exit.

Death effects preserve detach byte positions, control following, pending low-byte counts and cleanup. The detached Midnight Reaper worker retains its existing zero-card draw after consuming the loop count; the main card retains its separate damage/draw behavior.

Mass Manipulation retains paid/free/token paths, short-circuit flag queries, forced target chooser, human versus AI X storage, selection after payment, cached card versus refreshed target-player reads, and target cleanup. Incubation Druid retains its info_slot byte re-entry guard.

Deputy of Detention uses typed cards_data[iid].id reads in place of packed pointer arithmetic: card_data_t is 72 bytes, id offset 0x24, cc offset 0x2b. It preserves fresh id reads after callbacks and uses memset for the selection matrix.

Unstable commands retain target consumption, invalid-target markers, repeated first-target validation in command B, die-roll ordering and valid-target gating. Staff keeps the native byte-fold table and both special long names. Dialog implementations remain opaque.
One combined build follows. Historical replay, full inventories and reccmp regeneration remain deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
